<b>{{PAGENAME}}s</b> are a [[cooking]] resource used in various [[Fishing|fish]]-related recipes. It can either be crafted at the cooking table or purchased from the [[Lighthouse Keeper]].

As of the official release of the game, the copper-quality blue-fish-fillets are not available, as none of the fish that provide these fillets will ever spawn with a copper-quality.
